data.one_liner: Provides add‑to‑cart animation for any widget in Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: The package lets you animate any widget moving into a cart icon, with optional badge updates. It offers configurable drag and jump animations, duration, and curves.
use_when: You need a visual add‑to‑cart effect in a shopping or gamified UI
You want a ready‑made, cross‑platform animation without writing custom code
avoid_when: The UI is static and no cart interaction is required
You need a highly custom animation beyond the provided options
strengths: Simple API – just provide a GlobalKey and call the run function
Works on Android, iOS, web, desktop out of the box
Customizable duration, curve and badge visibility
weaknesses: Focused only on cart‑style animations, not a general animation framework
May add extra widget hierarchy and performance cost for simple lists

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: General purpose animation library with many effects and a declarative API

alternatives.name: loading_animation_widget
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides ready‑made loading animations if you only need simple visual feedback
